// Exposes the whole primitives a shape enumerates — segments, triangles, quads
// — alongside the points inside them. The view layer: an algorithm that only
// folds over primitives constrains on this and works for unwelded soups,
// indexed meshes and tessellated surfaces alike.
interface IPrimitiveGeometry<TPoint, TPrim>
    inherits IPointGeometry<TPoint>
{
    Primitives(x: Self): Array<TPrim>;
}
